topics.title: [DEMO] How should generative AI be governed in student assessment?
topics.description:
FLAGSHIP SIMULATION — no initial position is implied.

Context: Education systems are adapting assessment practice while generative AI changes how learners can produce, revise and explain work. UNESCO guidance emphasizes human-centred, age-appropriate, ethical and pedagogically validated use rather than treating AI as a universal solution.

Trigger: A fictional education authority asks for an assessment policy before the next academic year after inconsistent school-level rules create uncertainty for learners and teachers.

Decision task: Produce a policy framework covering disclosure, permitted uses, teacher judgement, learner rights, data protection, assessment validity and review.

Common evidence baseline: Guidance for generative AI in education and research; 2023 Global Education Monitoring Report: Technology in education — A tool on whose terms?; Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence; AI competency framework for students; AI competency framework for teachers.

Structured casting, evidence URLs, uncertainties, event injects, round plan and cross-World links are in the seed flagship source file.

topics.title: [DEMO] What obligations should education systems adopt to prevent digital learning from widening exclusion?
topics.description:
FLAGSHIP SIMULATION — no initial position is implied.

Context: Digital learning can expand access but may reproduce barriers involving devices, connectivity, language, disability, teacher support and household conditions. UNESCO monitoring frames technology choices through equity, relevance and sustainability.

Trigger: A fictional system is expanding blended learning nationally but has a fixed budget and evidence of unequal access among regions and learner groups.

Decision task: Define a minimum inclusion standard, priority investments, monitoring indicators and escalation rules for inaccessible or ineffective digital provision.

Common evidence baseline: 2023 Global Education Monitoring Report: Technology in education — A tool on whose terms?; Revised guidelines on the inclusion of learners with disabilities in open and distance learning; 2026 Global Education Monitoring Report: Access and equity; From access to agency: UNESCO strategy for gender equality in and through education 2026–2029.

Structured casting, evidence URLs, uncertainties, event injects, round plan and cross-World links are in the seed flagship source file.
